scripts.cf:dev: npm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && wrangler dev
scripts.cf:deploy: npm run build && npm run cf:migrate && wrangler deploy

SLOP_ROOSTER_ACCESS_UUID.description: Required. The shared access code creators sign in with. Use a fresh UUID (for example from `uuidgen`) and keep it private.

APP_SESSION_SECRET.description: Required. At least 32 random characters (for example `openssl rand -base64 48`); signs creator session cookies.

SHARE_TOKEN_SECRET.description: Required. At least 32 random characters, different from the session secret; signs protected viewing links. Changing it invalidates issued protected links.

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Optional. A Gemini API key enables **Generate Markdown**. Recording and sharing work without it.

DB.description: D1 database for recordings, sharing settings and Markdown jobs.

RECORDINGS.description: Private R2 bucket for the video files.
